name: Finger of Death (Hellenic)
body:
School necromancy [death]; Level Hellenic sorceress 5

CASTING

Casting Time 1 minute
Components V, S

EFFECT

Range long (400 ft. + 40 ft./level)
Target one living creature; see text
Duration instantaneous
Saving Throw Fortitude partial; Spell Resistance yes

DESCRIPTION

This spell guides the spirits of death to the target, who suffers an unfortunate accident or injury within 1d4 rounds, causing them to bleed to death (losing 3d6 damage +1 point per caster level per round, which can only be stopped with magical healing or a DC 30 Heal check). If the target’s Fortitude saving throw succeeds, it instead takes 3d6 points of damage + 1 point per caster level. The subject might die from damage even if it succeeds on its saving throw.

Because this form of the spell causes the target to bleed to death, it can affect nonliving creatures that are vulnerable to bleeding wounds.
